findings.finding: Tanzil lists Persian translations by Hossein Ansarian and Mohammad Mahdi Fooladvand in its translation repository.
Tanzil documents a 6236-line translation-file convention and requests source/publication/copyright-holder metadata for submitted translations.
Tanzil makes translations downloadable but explicitly states that it cannot guarantee authenticity or accuracy of all translations.
Tanzil exposes a change log for the Fooladvand translation, showing that the hosted digital text has had revisions.
Tanzil exposes a change log for the Ansarian translation, showing that the hosted digital text has had revisions.

rights_interpretation.reason: The Quran-text CC BY license page covers Tanzil Quran Text. It does not by itself establish republication rights for every hosted translation.
rights_interpretation.action: Keep translation artifacts quarantined/internal-research-only until source-specific rights evidence is verified.
